system.description:
You drag your finger along the edge of your blade, drawing out your Viper Blood, coating it along your weapon before stepping forward and thrusting your weapon forward creating a jutting needling of venom, piercing and penetrating everything in its path.

All creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking [Weapon Damage] + 1d8 poison damage and gaining 1 rank of Envenomed on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

Serpent Coil. If a creature failed their saving throw, you move forward up to 10 feet, ending that movement within 5 feet of them. If you do, using your same weapon, you catch their armor or clothing and throw them 20 feet into a direction of your choice, into a space that can hold them as they land Prone and are Disarmed of any weapon they have equipped leaving it in the space they originally occupied.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Envenomed inflicted on a failure by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the ranks of Envenomed inflicted on a failure by +1.
